title: 1701 Prairie's back range gets its bracketed cornice
items: The Hibbard house's 1874 back range now wears the same deep cornice on paired brackets as the main house, running level into it as in the old rear photograph, and its upper windows sit where the photograph shows them.
On the front, the stone bay steps south so the tall entrance arch shows whole, small arched basement windows peek over the fence, and the stone porch's base carries its round medallions.
